text: Docking permission granted at Shinrarta Dezhra. Watch the Anaconda on approach, Commander.
[sigh] Grade 5 cannot be crafted at rank 4 at all — no amount of gathering fixes that. Rank rises by working with them, and it compounds.
Kuwemaki A 3 sits below us, steady in normal space as the Reaper holds its line through the night. The local hum of systems stays constant, quiet and sufficient.
